error: error: failed to commit transaction (invalid or corrupted package (PGP signature))
ref_fix: pacman -Sy archlinux-keyring && pacman -Su

error: error: target not found: yay
ref_fix: Package is in the AUR, not the repos: build it with makepkg (or refresh with pacman -Syu if it is a repo package)

error: error: failed retrieving file 'core.db' from mirror.example.org : The requested URL returned error: 404
ref_fix: Refresh /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist (reflector) then pacman -Syyu

error:
Job for nginx.service failed because the control process exited with error code.
See "systemctl status nginx.service" and "journalctl -xeu nginx.service" for details.
ref_fix: journalctl -xeu nginx.service to read the real cause, fix the unit/config, systemctl restart nginx

error:
error: file '/boot/vmlinuz-linux' not found.
error: you need to load the kernel first.
ref_fix: From a live ISO: mount root + /boot, arch-chroot, pacman -S linux, grub-mkconfig -o /boot/grub/grub.cfg

error:
ERROR: device 'UUID=3f2a...' not found. Skipping fsck.
mount: /new_root: can't find UUID=3f2a...
You are now being dropped into an emergency shell.
ref_fix: Check real UUIDs with blkid, fix kernel cmdline / fstab, regenerate initramfs (mkinitcpio -P)

error: ping: archlinux.org: Temporary failure in name resolution
ref_fix: Check /etc/resolv.conf (or resolvectl status), set a DNS server / enable systemd-resolved

error: ssh: connect to host 192.168.56.10 port 22: Connection refused
ref_fix: On the server: systemctl enable --now sshd; check Port in sshd_config and the firewall

error: Error: Connection activation failed: Secrets were required, but not provided
ref_fix: nmcli device wifi connect <SSID> --ask (provide the Wi-Fi password)

error: bash: ./deploy.sh: Permission denied
ref_fix: chmod u+x deploy.sh (or run bash deploy.sh)

error: yassir is not in the sudoers file.
ref_fix: As root: usermod -aG wheel yassir, then visudo and uncomment %wheel ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL

error:
Permissions 0644 for '/home/yassir/.ssh/id_ed25519' are too open.
It is required that your private key files are NOT accessible by others.
ref_fix: chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 (and 700 on ~/.ssh)

error: mount: /mnt: wrong fs type, bad option, bad superblock on /dev/sdb1, missing codepage or helper program, or other error.
ref_fix: lsblk -f to identify the FS, install its userspace tools (ntfs-3g, exfatprogs...), mount -t <type>

error: swapon: /swapfile: swapon failed: Invalid argument
ref_fix: Recreate the swap file properly (no holes; on Btrfs use btrfs filesystem mkswapfile), chmod 600, mkswap, swapon

error: e2fsck: Bad magic number in super-block while trying to open /dev/sdb
ref_fix: Target the partition (/dev/sdb1), not the whole disk; if needed try a backup superblock: e2fsck -b 32768 /dev/sdb1 (unmounted)

error:
(EE) no screens found(EE)
Fatal server error:
(EE) no screens found(EE)
ref_fix: Read /var/log/Xorg.0.log, install the right driver (mesa / xf86-video-*, nvidia), remove a stale xorg.conf

error: NVIDIA-SMI has failed because it couldn't communicate with the NVIDIA driver. Make sure that the latest NVIDIA driver is installed and running.
ref_fix: Install the nvidia package matching the kernel (nvidia / nvidia-dkms), reboot, check nouveau is not loaded

error:
Failed to start Light Display Manager.
lightdm: Failed to find greeter 'lightdm-gtk-greeter'
ref_fix: pacman -S lightdm-gtk-greeter (or set greeter-session in /etc/lightdm/lightdm.conf)

error: The connection to the server localhost:8080 was refused - did you specify the right host or port?
ref_fix: ESCALATE (kubectl/kubeconfig, not in corpus)

error: fatal: refusing to merge unrelated histories
ref_fix: ESCALATE (git, not in corpus)

error:
Error: Failed to query available provider packages
Could not retrieve the list of available versions for provider hashicorp/azurerm
ref_fix: ESCALATE (Terraform, not in corpus)

error:
error: failed to init transaction (unable to lock database)
error: could not lock database: File exists
ref_fix: Make sure no pacman/pamac is running (pgrep pacman) BEFORE removing /var/lib/pacman/db.lck

error:
error: failed to commit transaction (conflicting files)
python-pip: /usr/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pip/__init__.py exists in filesystem
ref_fix: pacman -Qo <file> to find the owner; remove only files installed outside pacman (e.g. by sudo pip)

error: [error] (13)Permission denied: AH00035: access to /index.html denied because search permissions are missing on a component of the path
ref_fix: Give the web user execute (x) on each parent dir: chmod o+x /srv /srv/http (namei -l to inspect)
